verdict.rationale: Chargebee's custom MCP server feature lets you combine only selected tools (e.g., just subscription/invoice tools) into a server for an AI client, which is a form of least-privilege scoping for agent access [chargebee-docs-8][chargebee-docs-7]. However, the core REST API credentialing shown in docs only describes a 'Full-Access Key' with no documented scoped/role-based or read-only key options [chargebee-docs-17][chargebee-docs-1], so true least-privilege API credentials outside the MCP layer are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented scoped/restricted API key roles or permission tiers, independent confirmation of MCP tool-scoping in practice, and any audit/revocation controls for agent credentials.
